name: threat-stack
description: The front door of the threat-stack platform. Greets whoever opens the repo, explains the value flow (AUDIT ▸ MODEL ▸ EXTEND), lists only the installed plugins and the next command to run, and consolidates each plugin's readiness into one view. A thin orchestrator that delegates to the specialists (skillsentry, threat-modeler, supersize-*) by capability and never re-implements them.

metadata.note: commands/ and skills/ auto-discovered. SessionStart greeting via hooks/greet.sh. Delegates to skillsentry (AUDIT), threat-modeler (MODEL), supersize-* (EXTEND); never re-implements them.
